Subject: Missed discovery — quick rebook + decision criteria

Hi Tom —

Sorry we missed you on the scheduled discovery earlier today. Quick recap and proposal so we can keep momentum: 

Recap (from today's agenda):
- Primary use case: reducing per-token inference cost for batch document processing.
- Decision drivers: latency SLOs (95th perc < 200ms), predictable monthly spend, VPC/private deployment for PHI.
- Stakeholders: you (SaaS Ops), Eng lead (will need a technical deep dive), Procurement (for terms).

Next steps (asked of Starnet):
1) Confirm which of these two tightly constrained slots works — we have limited engineering availability this week. Please reply with EXACT slot or we release both: 
   - Option A: Wed, May 19 — 10:00–10:30 PT
   - Option B: Wed, May 19 — 16:15–16:45 PT
2) Which internal attendees will join from your side (eng/ops/procurement)?
3) If neither slot works, tell us one 30-minute window tomorrow (May 20) and we'll try to accommodate.

Decision criteria to bring to the call (this will help us prepare a short demo focused on what matters):
- What throughput and token-length distribution do you expect? (sample numbers help)
- Are you okay with quantized model variants if it means 2–3x lower cost?
- Minimal acceptable latency at 95th percentile

I've attached a short discovery-recap and a one-pager on Redwood's deployment modes to help prep. If we don't hear back by EOD tomorrow we'll follow-up once more and then open the slots to other trials.

Thanks —
Naomi Feldman
